comment: The Settings menu leaves the bar and its rows go to Help. On a fresh profile the bar draws no Settings button, Help holds Display Settings..., Tablet Settings... and one Keyboard Shortcuts row between two lines above About, and each of the three opens Preferences on its page. The rows are pressed by id, 508, 509 and 501, help_menu.gd's own constants. The dump's open_menus and windows arrays carry the rows and the page each press opened.
